title: DEBIASING VISON-LANGUAGE MODELS WITH TEXT-ONLY TRAINING

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset by evaluating the model's ability to classify bird species without relying on spuriously correlated land or water backgrounds.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset by evaluating hair color classification performance across male and female subgroups to test for spurious gender correlations.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset to ensure target classifications are robust against age-related spurious correlations.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset across various physical and accessory attributes (e.g., Chubby, Wearing Hat, Heavy Makeup, Big Nose, Wavy Hair) as spurious bias attributes.
